## Change

Describe the reader-visible correction or behavior and why it is needed.

## Evidence and context

For content changes: primary sources/DOI/PMID, population, exposure/form/route, measured analyte or outcome, limitations, and any conflicting evidence. State whether review status changes and who performed that review.

## Validation

Record checks actually run and their results. Include relevant desktop/mobile or database verification; passing tests does not substitute for source review.

## Attribution

List external assets or reused material, their licenses, attribution and modifications. Disclose relevant funding/conflicts. Do not include credentials or private records.
